Name: FS - Player Height Variety
Author: PeacefulEnd
Description:
[img]https://imgur.com/ZxqFOeh.png[/img][size=3]﻿
Player Height Variety is a [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/9969]Fashion Sense[/url] pack which adds custom bodies with different heights via the [url=https://github.com/Floogen/FashionSense/wiki/Hand-Mirror-Tool]Hand Mirror[/url] tool.
[/size]

[img]https://imgur.com/dJ0SIg8.png[/img]﻿
[img]https://imgur.com/1AAHxL5.gif[/img]﻿

[img]https://imgur.com/TZOSh4j.png[/img]﻿
[img]https://imgur.com/tLX01Hz.gif[/img]﻿




[img]https://imgur.com/fP5yPeU.png[/img]
[b][size=3]How do I use one of the preset outfits?[/size][/b]
[list]
[*][size=3]Use the Hand Mirror tool from the Fashion Sense framework, select the "Outfits" button and then click "Presets" in the top left.[/size]
[/list]
[b][size=3]Do all Fashion Sense appearances work with custom body heights?[/size][/b]
[list]
[*][size=3]All hairs, hats, shirts and sleeves should work without issue. Some accessories, pants and shoes may not align correctly, but most should not have an issue.[/size]
[/list]
[b][size=3]What is the difference between the standard and alternative body types?[/size][/b]
[list]
[*][size=3]The standard body type has curved eyebrows, while the alternative has straight eyebrows.[/size]
[/list]
[b][size=3]Why are my arms / boots invisible when using custom bodies?[/size][/b]
[list]
[*][size=3]When using custom bodies, the vanilla sleeves and boots will not render. You will need to use Fashion Sense sleeves and boots (the vanilla versions are already included with Fashion Sense, labeled "Default").[/size]
[/list]
